chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-'Alawi, from al-'Amraki, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the boy: when do fasting and prayer become obligatory upon him? He said: when he approaches puberty and comes to know prayer and fasting.

key_terms.الْحُلُمَ: puberty or the age of sexual maturity
key_terms.الْغُلَامِ: the boy under discussion in the ruling

ai.seo_question: When do salat (prayer) and sawm (fasting) become obligatory for a boy in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses when religious duty begins for a boy with respect to salat (prayer) and sawm (fasting). It indicates obligation upon nearing puberty together with recognition and understanding of these acts of worship, making it significant in discussions of the legal onset of accountability.
